channel.title: The Local Cabinetry news
channel.description: Guides, projects and product news from The Local Cabinetry: how to measure, how to plan, and what goes into our cabinets.

item.title: How to measure your kitchen in feet: a 5-minute guide
item.description: Measure your kitchen wall by wall in feet and inches in about five minutes, with a simple checklist of what to note, so we can draw a layout with you.

item.title: RTA vs assembled kitchen cabinets: what you actually get
item.description: Ready-to-assemble and pre-assembled cabinets compared in plain terms: what arrives, who builds it, what it costs you in time, and when each one makes sense.

item.title: Walk-in closet planning: depth, hanging zones and lighting
item.description: How to plan a walk-in closet: how deep to make it, how to split hanging, shelves and drawers into zones, and where lighting helps most.
